item.title: How to Change Corner Radius in PowerPoint
item.description: Preparing a poster for an upcoming conference, I found myself wanting to standardize the roundness of the rounded-rectagle boxes across my slides. Dragging the little yellow dot that appears in PowerPoint surely isn’t the most efficient way to get consistent results. I wanted every box to have exactly the same corner radius. Surprinsingly, there is no way to do this in the native Powerpoint interface. A solution is to use VBA, the Visual Basic for Applications engine.
